findings.note: Texas Legislature Online lists Sparks among the Senate authors of SB 16 (Hughes), filed 2025-03-11, which requires documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote; he is on the list with a filing date of 03/11/2025. His third-reading yea vote is already on file.

findings.passage: SB 706 requires Texas to honor all valid out-of-state carry licenses. SB 1596 legalizes short-barreled firearms (federal laws still apply). SB 1403 protects firearm privacy for foster parents. SB 1718 includes NRA meetings in the Major Events Reimbursement Program. SB 1362 bans enforcement of “red flag” laws.
